sheets.prompt: Production asset for AshenSpire, a painted dark-fantasy 2D combat game. Generate ONE coherent SIX-FRAME animation sheet in exactly 3 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS, row-major chronological order, six EQUAL SQUARE cells on a 3:2 canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background; no background color, checkerboard, labels, grid lines, characters, objects or scenery. Each effect must stay inside the central 68% of its cell, leaving wide completely transparent gutters. Identical center anchor in all cells, consistent drawing scale, deliberate distinct temporal shapes, not six copies resized. Frames 1 through 6: anticipation mark, gathering motion, leading release, peak contact, dissipating trail, last few fading fragments. Crisp painterly facets and controlled translucent edges, readable at 128 pixels. Reference image is the existing in-game effect for identity and general silhouette, not an image to repeat in all cells. Update mundane BLADE SLASH: a slender tapered silver-gray crescent opening toward LEFT and moving RIGHT, a crisp narrow ivory cutting edge and translucent graphite wake. More elegant and sharper than the reference's thick blurred glow. No blue magic, no neon, no opaque disk, no actual weapon, no blood. Arc builds across frames, cuts cleanly in frame 4, then breaks into 2 to 3 thin gray streaks and fades. Modest visual footprint suitable for a normal one-action Strike.
sheets.correctionPrompt: Edit this exact six-frame sprite sheet. Keep the SIX chronological effects in their existing identical 3 column by 2 row layout and retain their shapes, colors, sizes and positions. Completely remove EVERY checkerboard pattern, including the pattern showing through translucent trails. Replace the entire background and negative spaces with one perfectly uniform flat solid chroma key GREEN, RGB(0,255,0), hex #00FF00. No gradient, checkerboard, shadows, text, lines or texture in the background. Repaint translucent trails as clean foreground colored fine strokes with antialiased edges over the uniform green. Preserve fine ivory/gray edges, blue/violet crystal filaments, crimson ribbons or ochre sparks as present. This is a technical keying plate: the green is intentional and will be removed in our exporter. Do NOT depict transparency as checkerboard. Do not add green to the artwork. Ensure wide green gutters between the six cells.

sheets.prompt: Create a production dark fantasy combat VFX SPRITE SHEET on a perfectly uniform FLAT SOLID PURE GREEN background #00FF00. The green matte is intentional, it will be keyed out by an exporter. SIX DIFFERENT chronological animation frames arranged in exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, 1536x1024 canvas, equal 512px square cells. All six effects share a consistent center anchor and drawing scale. Leave a 60px flat green margin inside each cell so no effect touches cell boundaries. No text, no grid, no checker pattern, no background scene, no shadows on the green. Crisp painterly shapes. No transparent looking checker pattern anywhere, not even in the trails; trails are thin foreground colored strokes over flat green. Do not use green within the effects. Frames: 1 a small anticipation mark; 2 gathering; 3 release; 4 strongest contact; 5 breaking apart; 6 sparse faint flecks. Update SHIELD BASH into a mundane physical impact traveling toward the RIGHT: short compressed ivory-steel crescent, ochre contact sparks, slate fragments and restrained gray dust. Clearly broad blunt contact, not blade slash. Small directional contact point remains near cell center. No actual shield or weapon, no electric blue, no neon, no magic aura, no fireball, no enclosing glow cloud. Frame 4 has a concentrated irregular metal collision with 4 to 6 tiny warm sparks; frame 6 leaves only two dim dust flecks.
